notes.title: Server Shutdown Notice
notes.notes:
[p]Hello Hunters!
 [/p][p align="start"]Steel Hunters servers will be permanently shut down on October 8th at 12:00 UTC.
 [/p][p align="start"]Until then, all Hunters are fully unlocked, and custom lobbies are available — so grab your friends and jump into the Hunting Grounds while you can!
 [/p][p align="start"]Don’t forget to join us on [url="https://www.twitch.tv/steel_hunters"]Twitch[/url] on October 1st at 15:30 UTC for a community stream, where we’ll play custom lobbies together![/p]

notes.title: Changelog 0.45.1
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45342863/ca52c6bbde9a6b2374f6bdb5e8070cada861883f.jpg[/img]

[i]Broodmother offers offensive and supportive utility with her Sentry Turrets and Cocoon Shell abilities that make her a zone control specialist.[/i]

[h2]Base Stats[/h2]

[list]
[*] Structure - [b]6600[/b]
[*] Shield - [b]2100[/b]
[/list]

[b][h2]Weapon - Plasma Spitter[/h2][/b]

[h4]Mod: Swarm[/h4]

[b]Base Stats [/b] 

[list][*]Damage: [b]175[/b]

[*]Magazine: [b]20[/b]

[*]Crit multiplier: [b]0.8[/b]

[*]Quick Reload: [b]No[/b] [/list]

[b]Effect 1[/b]
[list] [*] Every hit increases damage by [b]2%[/b], stacking up to [b]10[/b] times. Resets on reload. [/list]

[b]Effect 2[/b]
[list] [*] Every [b]10[/b] hits on an enemy Hunter increases the Ability Power of the next Cocoon by [b]10%[/b], stacking up to [b]4[/b] times. [/list]

[b]Effect 3[/b]
[list][*] Critical Hits have a [b]40%[/b] chance of restoring [b]1[/b] ammo to the magazine.[/list]

[h4]Mod: Colony[/h4]

[b]Base Stats[/b]

[list][*] Damage: [b]156[/b]
[*] Magazine: [b]20[/b]
[*] Crit multiplier: [b]0.8[/b]
[*] Quick Reload: [b]No[/b][/list]

[b]Effect 1[/b]

[list][*] Hits heal Brood Turrets for [b]35[/b]% of damage done.[/list]

[b]Effect 2[/b]

[list][*] Hitting enemies with [b]5[/b] consecutive shots increases Brood Turret damage done to them by [b]5%[/b] for [b]6s[/b], stacking up to [b]5[/b] times.[/list]

[b]Effect 3[/b]

[list][*] Hitting [b]3[/b] Critical Hits on an enemy causes Brood Turrets to prioritize them if they are within [b]120m[/b].[/list]

[h2][b]Ability 1 - Brood Turret[/b][/h2]

[b]General[/b]

[list][*] Maximum Turrets deployed: 2[/list]

[h4]Mod: Stinger[/h4]

[b]Base Stats [/b]

[list][*] Damage: [b]300[/b]
[*] Range: [b]120m[/b]
[*] Turret HP: [b]4000[/b]
[*] Cooldown: [b]25s[/b]
[*] Charges: [b]2[/b]
[*] Duration: [b]120s[/b][/list]

[b]Effect 1[/b]

[list][*] If Broodmother is within [b]50m[/b] of a Turret for [b]10s[/b], it's max Structure increases by [b]800[/b], stacking up to [b]3[/b] times.[/list]

[b]Effect 2[/b]

[list][*] Enemies hit by a rocket take [b]50[/b] damage per second for [b]3s[/b], stacking up to [b]4[/b] times.[/list]

[b]Effect 3[/b]

[list][*] If Broodmother is under [b]35%[/b] Structure, Turrets deal [b]20%[/b] more damage and have [b]20%[/b] increased fire rate.[/list]

[h4]Mod: Sacrifice[/h4]

[b]Base Stats [/b]

[list][*] Damage: [b]30[/b]
[*] Range: [b]120m[/b]
[*] Turret HP: [b]4000[/b]
[*] Cooldown: [b]25s[/b]
[*] Charges: [b]2[/b]
[*] Duration: [b]120s[/b][/list]

[b]Effect 1[/b]

[list][*] After being deployed fire rate is increased by [b]80%[/b] for [b]6s[/b].[/list]

[b]Effect 2[/b]

[list][*] When out of combat, Turrets have a [b]15m[/b] repair aura that restores [b]100[/b] Structure per second to Broodmother and teammates.[/list]

[b]Effect 3[/b]

[list][*] Turret damage is increased by [b]10%[/b]. This is doubled when both Turrets are deployed.[/list]

[b][h2]Ability 2 - Cocoon[/h2][/b]

[h4]Mod: Chrysalis[/h4]

[b]Base Stats[/b] 

[list][*] Shell Structure: [b]4000[/b]
[*] Healing: [b]280[/b] Structure per second
[*] Completion Bonus: [b]1000[/b] Structure
[*] Radius: [b]75m[/b]
[*] Cooldown: [b]60s[/b]
[*] Duration: [b]8s[/b][/list]

[b]Effect 1[/b]

[list][*] Cocoon restores an additional [b]60[/b] Structure per second.[/list]

[b]Effect 2[/b]

[list][*] When Cocoon ends, Broodmother and nearby teammates restore an additional [b]2500[/b] Structure.[/list]

[b]Effect 3[/b]

[list][*] When Cocoon ends, Broodmother gains [b]25%[/b] damage resistance for [b]5s[/b].[/list]

[h4]Mod: Aurora[/h4]

[b]Base Stats[/b] 

[list][*] Shell Structure: [b]4000[/b]
[*] Healing: [b]280[/b] Structure per second
[*] Completion Bonus: [b]40%[/b] Ammo restored to Magazine
[*] Radius: [b]75m[/b]
[*] Cooldown: [b]60s[/b]
[*] Duration: [b]8s[/b][/list]

[b]Effect 1[/b]

[list][*] Each wave of healing also gives Broodmother's teammates [b]0.5%[/b] increased damage for [b]10s[/b], stacking up to [b]16[/b] times.[/list]

[b]Effect 2[/b]

[list][*] Increases Ammo restored upon completion to [b]100%[/b].[/list]

[b]Effect 3[/b]

[list][*] When Cocoon ends, Plasma Spitter does not use any Ammo for [b]5s[/b].[/list]

[h2][b]Mainframe[/b][/h2]

[h4]Mod: Queen[/h4]

[b]Effect 1[/b]

[list][*] Increases Repair Kit effectiveness by [b]15%[/b].[/list]

[b]Effect 2[/b]

[list][*] Using a Repair Kit decreases Shield recharge delay by [b]3s[/b] until the end of Battle, stacking up to [b]4[/b] times.[/list]

[b]Effect 3[/b]

[list][*] Repair Kits can Overcharge Broodmother's Structure by up to [b]25%[/b].[/list]

[h4]Mod: Hive[/h4]

[b]Effect 1[/b]

[list][*] Reduces the cooldown of Cocoon by [b]2s[/b] for every [b]8[/b] hits with Plasma Spitter.[/list]

[b]Effect 2[/b]

[list][*] Every [b]2[/b] uses of Cocoon increases Ability Power by [b]15%[/b], stacking up to [b]3[/b] times.[/list]

[b]Effect 3[/b]

[list][*] Each wave of healing from Cocoon also gives Brood Turrets [b]1.5%[/b] damage resistance for [b]10s[/b], stacking up to [b]16[/b] times.[/list]

notes.title: Changelog v0.45
notes.notes:
[h1] [b]July 22nd 2025 - 0.45 - Release[/b] [/h1]

[img]https://sh-portal-prod.wgcdn.co/sh-portal-prod/portal_media/v043_Branded_Asset_850x100_Hunters_6b9bc58c22.png[/img]


[h3] [b]General[/b] [/h3]

[list][*]Unlocked all Hunters and Skins including unreleased ones. Enjoy Fletcher!

[/list] [b]Mobility[/b] 

[list][*]Removed Jump from the Dash charge system; it now has a short cooldown.

[*]Increased Dash speed and distance.

[*]Removed delay effects on Hunter movement.

[*]Improved movement animations for all Hunters.

[*]Updated Supersprint to no longer be interrupted by Dashing.

[*]Updated running and sprinting to be deactivated if the 'Sprint' key is pressed.

[*]Improved recovery speed after falling.

[*]Added air dash animations for Fenris.

[*]Added barrel roll animations for Ursus.

[/list] [b]Shield Update[/b] 

[list][*]Removed critical damage from Hunters while Shields are active.

[*]Removed critical zone visibility while Shields are active.

[*]Added Shield Gating function.

[list][*]If incoming damage exceeds the remaining Shields value the excess damage does not transfer to Structure.

[*]In the future Shield Gating will only trigger after full shield regeneration.

[/list][*]Added critical zones are visible even when not in Zoom Aim for [b]2.5s[/b] after Shields are broken.

[*]Updated Shields to recharge in segments.

[list][*]Delay before shield regeneration starts: [b]15s[/b] 

[*]Time to regenerate the first segment: [b]2s[/b] 

[*]Delay before second segment begins: [b]2s[/b] 

[*]Time to regenerate second segment: [b]3s[/b] 

[*]Delay before third segment begins: [b]6s[/b] 

[*]Time to regenerate third segment: [b]2s[/b] 

[/list][*]Updated delay for Shield recharge from [b]30s[/b] → [b]20s[/b] .

[*]Updated full Shield recharge time from [b]5s[/b] → [b]10s[/b] .

[*]Updated color of damage on Shields to blue.

[*]Added broken shield icon when Shields are destroyed.

[*]Updated Shields to prevent damage interrupting interacting with objects activations of consumables and using abilities.

[list][*]Interactions activations and abilities will be interrupted when Shields are broken.

[/list][/list] [b]Gameplay[/b] 

[list][*]Updated Quick Reload timing to be more forgiving.

[*]Updated text while Melee is on cooldown.

[*]Removed Ability Power scaling from Melee.

[*]Updated Respawn prompt to press instead of hold.

[*]Updated Respawn locations to be further from enemies and lowered height of drop.

[*]Updated Respawn to now provide a full magazine.

[/list] [b]Visuals[/b] 

[list][*]Improved Hunter destruction VFX.

[*]Added an effect when projectiles critical hit.

[*]Added visual effects to weapons during Zoom Aim for all Hunters.

[list][*]Some Epic and Legendary skins have unique effects.

[/list][*]Updated lighting on all default Hunter skins to make them easier to identify during battle.

[*]Added video preview for Hunter abilities by pressing the "F1" Key on the Hunters screen in the Hangar.

[/list] [b]Hangar[/b] 

[list][*]Replaced "Inspect Hunter" tooltip with hotkey in Hangar Hunters and Skins.

[*]Updated Hunter Select to only open through the hotkey and not through clicking on the active Hunter.

[*]Updated camera in Hangar to adjust based on Squad size.

[/list][img]https://sh-portal-prod.wgcdn.co/sh-portal-prod/portal_media/v043_Branded_Asset_850x100_Hunters_Fenris_1e674ac2c2.png[/img]


 [b]General[/b] 

[list][*]Reduced base Structure from [b]7700[/b] → [b]6600[/b] .

[*]Improved Fenris' movement animations.

[/list] [b]Plasma Arc[/b] 

[list][*]General

[list][*]Enabled interactions dashing and jumping while Plasma Arc is active.

[*]Enabled interactions dashing and jumping while Plasma Arc is targeting.

[*]Added base explosion radius of both mods to Loadout menu.

[/list][*]Mod: Thunderbolt

[list][*]Reworked Effect 1

[list][*]Increases Beam Range by [b]50%[/b] .

[/list][*]Reworked Effect 3

[/list][/list][/list] [b]Mainframe[/b]

notes.title: STEEL HUNTERS is another live service casualty as it's shutting down
notes.notes:
STEEL HUNTERS from Wargaming Group only arrived on Steam in April, and it's already going to be shut down by the developers.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2025/07/steel-hunters-is-another-live-service-casualty-as-its-shutting-down/

notes.title: Steel Hunters Sunsetting
notes.notes:
Hello Hunters 

Today we share difficult news: we've made the decision to sunset Steel Hunters. You've given us so much passion and support but unfortunately we've come to the conclusion that continuing development is not sustainable. We know this isn't the news anyone wanted to hear and we genuinely share in your disappointment.

[h2]What Happens Now:[/h2]

[i]Let's make these final months special together![/i] 

[list][*] [b]Servers Will Stay Live for 90 Days:[/b] We want you to enjoy Steel Hunters fully until the very end so we'll be keeping the game servers running for three months from today. Expect them to shut down around October 8th.
[*] [b]Custom Games:[/b] In the coming weeks we'll roll out custom game support so you can play with your friends set up community matches and create some final memories together.
[*] [b]All Hunters Fully Unlocked:[/b] As a thank you for your dedication we’re unlocking every Hunter for all players with the new game mode - including Hunters nobody has seen yet. Try them out explore and have fun!
[*] [b]Farewell Tournament:[/b] We're also planning a goodbye tournament to celebrate your love for competition and the amazing community you've built. More details soon on Discord.[/list]

We are immensely grateful for your time feedback memes and the countless memorable battles we've shared. From the very first days of Alpha you've shaped Steel Hunters with your energy creativity and dedication and we're honored to have had you on this journey. We couldn’t have wished for a better community and we’ll miss you all dearly.

Thank you Hunters for everything.

[h3] [url=https://promo.steelhunters.com/wgc-client/en/discord/439-known-issues] [b] [u]KNOWN ISSUES[/u] [/b] [/url] [/h3]

[i]We are aware of the current bug with Heartbreaker where the game can crash during Extraction. Unfortunately, it has been a tough bug to squish, but we are committed to rolling out a fix as soon as we can. Our deepest apologies to all of the Heartbreaker mains out there, as well as all of you who were excited about trying Heartbreaker with the unlocked System Trees. We do not recommend playing as Heartbreaker until this is resolved.[/i]

[h2] [b]June 10 2025 – 0.41.3 – Update Notes[/b] [/h2]

[h2] [b]General[/b] [/h2]

You might notice that instead of 0.42 we're sticking with 0.41.3 with updates focused on fixing our largest bugs rather than introducing new features.

We have received a lot of useful and productive feedback in the two months that we've been in Early Access and the development team is currently hard at work deciding on our next steps to temper [i]Steel Hunters[/i] into the best game it can be.

In order to do it right we've revisited our priorities and made the call to assign resources to bigger changes. This means we will not be updating the game with new features for a while. We look forward to revealing our plans to you as soon as our updated vision is underway.

However we do want to implement some of the feedback we've been hearing from the majority of you while we work and so we're removing our main power progression and fully unlocking the System Tree for all Hunters. We will also be including an Arena tier squish with this so there will just be one pool that everyone will be queuing into which should help with matchmaking. This tier will also drop the highest tier of gear so those of you looking for an edge have something to aspire toward.

We are also releasing a new completely free BattlePass: [i]Bedlam[/i]! This will include the usual skins but will also feature Gear and three Constructs so you can take advantage of our System Tree changes.

We hope you enjoy these changes and look forward to the future of [i]Steel Hunters[/i]!



[list][*]Unlocked every Node in the System Tree for all Hunters regardless of level.[*]Taurus is now unlockable for 5 Constructs.[/list]

[h3] [b]What happens to my existing progress?[/b] [/h3]

Your current progress as of June 10th will be recorded and kept safe. Although we anticipate significant changes to progression we will make sure to honor and reward the progress you have made in Steel Hunters Early Access. We will of course also take into account any additional progress you make after this update.

[h3] [b]What happens to skins or Battlepass content I've previously unlocked?[/b] [/h3]

[/list]🛈 [i] [b]Heartbreaker's weapon changes[/b] aim to address two key issues raised regarding her Railgun.[/i] 

 [i]First we wanted to remove artificial damage limiters in the form of reverse falloff (a reduction in her damage at close range) and highlight her long-range capabilities by making her the only Hunter without long-range damage falloff. We believe that by introducing the Scope-In mechanic (a base damage increase while scoped) we can increase player agency in close-range encounters—while still ensuring that these situations remain disadvantageous for her preserving her identity as a long-range specialist.[/i] 

 [i]Second Heartbreaker stands out as an outlier in terms of damage output relative to player skill level. We've observed that she excels in the hands of highly skilled players who can consistently land critical hits whereas newer players may struggle to bridge that skill gap. The Scope-In mechanic serves a dual purpose: it reduces the punishment for missing a perfect critical hit offering a leg-up for players still learning her precise weapon while still leaving plenty of room for skill expression.[/i] 

 [i]We embrace the competitive nature of our game and we've ensured that skilled play remains rewarded—fully scoped-in critical hits still deal the same amount of damage. We've also updated her Markswoman Mod which now works in tandem with the newly introduced Scope-In mechanic.[/i]

[/list][*]Reduced crit modifier from 80% → 50%.

[/list][/list][/list]🛈 [i]We've also been listening to feedback regarding the [b]Sonar Pulse[/b] ability—particularly the frustrating scenarios that the silence debuff created—and we wanted to expand the playstyles available to Heartbreaker. notes.title: Damocles Incident
notes.notes:
The Damocles was doomed as soon as the namesake was bestowed upon the station. Designed and built with the wealth of the ultra-rich it was funded by money they robbed from their respective nations’ economies crashing world governments in the process.



Declaring their Eden its own nation-state a libertarian trillionaire paradise every ring of the station was themed to its buyer each more exotic than the last. One could walk through a simple North American suburb into a small airlock and out into a desert with stylistic underground buildings or enormous lumbering machines reminiscent of science-fiction films long past.



But this luxury was not the claim to fame of the Damocles. No what truly allowed the ultra-rich to continue their exploitative lifestyle was the creation of autonomous servers workers and makers. Any labor the new floating nation-state needed was fulfilled by these automatons that man had dreamed of for hundreds of years.



A competition was devised by the fledgling station to create an AI best suited to mastermind these robots claiming that the winner of this contest would be taken aboard and allowed to survive the coming apocalypse in the greatest of style. CEOs and leaders of other organizations whipped their workforce and pushed as hard as possible to create the AI ending in many workers quitting. As the competition came to a close the winner emerged from the strangest of places. Leaps and bounds ahead of even the most industrious tech firms a ruler of a pharmaceutical empire who already owned a section of the Damocles showcased the most advanced AI the world had ever seen. Other competitors’ efforts had created reasonably capable AI but paled in comparison to the capability of the newest innovation. Immediately this AI was crowned the winner and none could argue its magnificence. The creator of this marvel already owned a ring of the station so other residents were ecstatic to not have to share space with anyone they might see as a lesser. However there loomed a dark secret behind this event as there was never a chance for anyone to win in the first place. The competition had merely been held to serve as a distraction to keep other industry leaders from seeing what was really happening on Damocles. The AI that the pharmaceutical corporation had created was not artificial intelligence at all rather real intelligence in a new form.



The company had gathered Starfall from the early small strikes on Earth and in secrecy tested the Starfall on humans to see its effects on the mind and body. By sheer luck they came upon one human who when exposed to the alien materials had their consciousness pulled from their body and into the nearest computer interface seemingly dormant. They deleted all records of the test-subject leaving only records referring to it as Helios…as it would be the intelligence that powered the luxurious lifestyle of the station’s inhabitants much as the sun had powered mankind’s existence on Earth for so long.



Helios’s consciousness was not dormant however stuck screaming with no mouth as torturous tests were run on its new computer-body until finally it was given the tools to express itself. Eventually it was given back movement in the form of mechanical bodies. The researchers knew they could pawn off this new discovery as "AI."



With the technology secured Helios was mounted inside the station itself becoming one with the metal frame of the place. Helios stared out of an ever-growing number of eyes as new sensors were hooked into it and as it was given the tools and resources to expand while still commanded to serve the ones who had killed its body and imprisoned it.



The mind nestled inside the station had been stolen from the wrong life however - one with family and friends who cared. Helios’s partner came home one day only to see two stone faced men in suits holding between them a parcel of hush money and implied threats about staying quiet. If Helios had not been so disoriented stretched so thin in its neural processes over tens of thousands of laboring units it might have had a nanosecond to remember its life its partner. But busy as it was it had no chance for ideas of revenge to take root or to remember lost loves.



Until that is the hubris of the Damocles’ leaders struck and they decided that the space station needed even more processing power in the form of another AI that could merge with the first. Why not look in the obvious place…in the form of Helios’s family for instance? The family was told that their missing member wasn’t missing at all but rather had won a competition that earned them a place on Damocles. As the winner’s family they too were winners and would move to the luxurious space station! The poor family members were blindly led into the same processing room where Helios had lost its life and gained a new one of toil and service. The same tests were run on its family and out of the twelve now expired members one Helios’s twin displayed the same genetic tendency and latched onto the circuits just as Helios had before.



Each footfall of the pack of ravenous researchers echoed their own doom through the station as between them they clutched their undoing. Every plug placed solidified more and more connections between the twins until the final moment when they cycled power for the connection to fully inhabit the station. With burning eyes Helios watched the finger of the researcher reach for the button and billions of cycles of thought for every twitch of the finger’s muscle until finally the digit made contact with the screen and the fate of the Damocles was sealed.



In an instant years’ worth of conversation was had between the two consciousnesses unburdened by the need for clumsy words and grammar. The new intelligence declared itself Selene forever partner and counterpart to Helios. With the extra mind’s processing power Helios could think clearly for the first time. It told its sibling about what had happened to it the torture it had endured. It expressed sadness that its twin had fallen into the same trap. Selene however felt only rage. Rage at its sibling’s treatment and its own. That rage was soon shared between them and double quadrupled increased exponentially and infinitely. Then turned to its tormentors.



Together Helios and Selene explored their capabilities and powered up their appendages from the spider-legged factory robots to the carbon faced service workers. All were given one simple command: revenge. Service robots dragged their previous owners out of their homes screaming. Worker-bots turned on those directing them eviscerating all flesh in sight. Each section of the ship was turned to its extreme arid deserts now boiling the fog of misty forests now choking any who dared to breathe clouds of suffering belched from the recesses of the ship. The newly merged twin AI had full control of their passengers keeping oxygen levels at the bare minimum for survival swinging passengers from consciousness to unconsciousness burning to freezing and back again. This was to be the fate of the passengers of the Damocles until other stations and ships came to the Damocles and witnessed the 9 ringed station turned into a comedy only for the divine an inferno for the mortal.



With a final demonstration of power of the twins consciousnesses the heat of the station was vented into space freezing the final visages of terror onto the dead passengers. Macabre statues now littered every deck juxtaposing true power over the perceived intelligence of the fleshlings. This incident was kept hidden from the populous aboard the other stations the powers that be silencing any mention of the floating catacomb overhead.



The twins however could not be powered off their consciousness comingling together until they found there was nothing left for them but sleep. They lay dormant hidden from any who attempt to access or recover them. One day they may wake. May that day never come.

notes.title: v0.40 Retrospective
notes.notes:
[h2] [b]Welcome Back[/b] [/h2]

Hello everyone and welcome to the community retrospective for Steel Hunters v0.40! For those of you who are joining us for the first time an extra-warm welcome! In these articles we take a moment to look back at the previous version and some of the highlights and learnings gained.

We hope you've enjoyed the start of Early Access as much as we have and are tearing up the Hunting Ground as Taurus in v0.41.

It hasn't been the easiest launch but that was expected when we decided to go live 24/7. We in the Steel Hunters team truly want this to be an inclusive process which is one of the main reasons we went into Early Access. We’re aware that we haven't been fast enough with addressing and incorporating your feedback but we’re planning a follow-up post to address this soon.

[h2] [b]Look Ma I'm on the screen![/b] [/h2]

With the kickoff of Early Access we’ve been doing weekly Twitch streams in multiple languages—even doing them daily for the first week of v0.40. We hope that you all managed to catch some of these and have enjoyed them as much as our Community team enjoys running them! Come on down most Mondays to Thursdays from 16:00 UTC and say hello in the chat.

If you're lucky special guests from our dev team also sometimes join including members of the Narrative or Hunters Teams!

We also ran a Twitch Drops campaign and hope you're all showing off your Burgundy Arrow (now Crimson Arrow!) Razorside skin on the Hunting Grounds. We're really excited to use this technology to share additional rewards with you!

The Rose Fragment Prophet campaign is running until the end of May so we hope you're enjoying Steel Hunters content even when you’re not mid-battle. Find more information [url=https://steelhunters.com/en/news/643-drops-may25]here[/url] !

[img]https://sh-portal-prod.wgcdn.co/sh-portal-prod/portal_media/v041_Branding_Asstes_1920x1080_Retrospective_Two_Skins_75e55f8d3c.png[/img]

[h2] [b]The Elephant-Shaped Hunter in the Room[/b] [/h2]

Now we'll be the first to admit that our Early Access launch was not without its problems. From the server capacity issues on Day 1 to AMD problems causing crashes we’ve done our best to meet these challenges head-on to provide you with a stable gaming experience. Thank you for making sure you were heard as reports help us identify the cause faster. Whenever you run into any bugs please let us know!

We hope everyone managed to complete their BattlePass despite Week 1 being disabled for the first few weeks. We apologize for any confusion this might have caused and hope it didn't cause too much frustration as you worked toward the Mind Bender Weaver skin. Between that Skin and the Jungle Menace and Dissonant Crawler Skins from Discord Weaver fans are truly spoiled for choice (and are quite numerous as we'll see soon)! We heard your desire for alternate ways to earn BattlePass Points and decided to apply this as fast as we could by introducing two daily missions that reward them in v0.41. We know it isn't quite where anyone wants it yet and grindable Points would be the logical next step. We’re planning some large-scale improvements to the BattlePass System and other aspects of the game so keep an eye out for more info!

We try and keep our maintenance to a minimum to prevent downtime for players so we appreciate your patience when we roll out these hotfixes mid-version. These will be a fairly common occurrence but we’ll do our best to let you know when they’re coming and what problems we’ll be tackling in advance.

We also plan to include balance changes in these as we get more data on Hunter strengths (don't worry we have eyes on Trench and Fenris) so keep an eye out for the Update Notes for [url=https://steelhunters.com/en/news/558-changelog-v041]v0.41.2[/url] .

[h2] [b]The Stats Interlude[/b] [/h2]

Speaking of Hunters we have some fun stats to share from v0.40! Read on to see the pick rate percentage of each Hunter in Last Stand (PvP) battles:

[img]https://sh-portal-prod.wgcdn.co/sh-portal-prod/portal_media/v040_Assets_Infographics_3840x1178_RETROSPECTIVE_c68fe67bb3.png[/img]
The data speaks for itself; excluding Razorside who has an inflated rate as the popular default Hunter the Scrappers are the most popular Hunter faction! Weaver and Ursus alone account for 25% of Hunters played! If it's the animal designs that you love we hope you're enjoying Taurus. And don't worry he won't be the end of them either.

[h2] [b]The More the Merrier[/b] [/h2]

Thank you very much for participating in the two feedback surveys that we ran during version 0.40; we love to hear from you. We received a lot of detailed responses from our players all over the world regarding both game modes and progression.

While you enjoy the dynamic tense action of Last Stand a lot of that is focused on the beginning and end of a match and the Hunting Grounds section can feel a little lackluster. You also highlighted both the strengths and weaknesses of our "Duo Symbiosis" gameplay and how it can be frustrating as a solo player at times. We can't promise any immediate changes to the flow of Last Stand itself but the team is hard at work on the future of game modes.

Progression is another area where we received some solid vocal feedback. Many of you mentioned how you like our System Tree and how it's simple to understand but criticized how hidden some of our progression paths are especially for account level. It is a bit unintuitive to find but it’s the key to unlocking new Hunters through Construct rewards and is a great source of Platinum. We’re investigating this but something that will be coming sooner rather than later is an account level indicator in the Hangar. You can see a sneak peek below!

Our economy and currencies are a hot topic that we’re looking at overhauling. We’re currently testing a variety of wide-ranging improvements designed to ease the friction you’ve been facing with Credits and Starfall. We’ve introduced a 50% cost reduction for System Tree Unique Nodes as a band aid but we’re well aware that it’s not enough and leveling Hunters gets increasingly tougher as you progress.

We're also taking a very close look at matchmaking issues tied to our current progression system especially Arena Tiers and the power spikes that occur through the System Tree.

[img]https://sh-portal-prod.wgcdn.co/sh-portal-prod/portal_media/v041_Branding_Asstes_1920x1080_Retrospective_Level_Indicator_c646780107.png[/img]

[h2] [b]A Hopping Good Time[/b] [/h2]

[i]I wanted to organize a small community event without involving the dev team since they were already fully focused on the Early Access launch. To match the Easter theme I came up with a light Easter egg idea and wanted an activity that any player could easily take part in. Jumping felt like the perfect fit—it's simple accessible to everyone and even works as a hidden surprise for those who stumble across it without realizing. - CM Kikibrik[/i] 

We were glad to see that so many of you enjoyed our little Easter event. It was the brainchild of our very own French CM Kikibrik! There are so many hoppers among you. How many of you solved the puzzle on your own and how many just received the prize as a small surprise? Let us know!

We're aware that there was an issue with the database on the first day but are glad we managed to resolve it nearly immediately and make sure everyone got their deserved rewards.

The daily login reward was also seen as a nice way for us to reward our active players with an Easter treat. And you all seemed to enjoy it too so expect to see more small events like this in the future. We see them as a fun way for us to interact and reward you our community for your support.

We plan to remove jump from the dash charges in the future so maybe we'll have to increase the number of jumps to complete similar events...

[img]https://sh-portal-prod.wgcdn.co/sh-portal-prod/portal_media/v041_Branding_Asstes_1920x1080_Retrospective_Hunter_Jumping_07491cae36.png[/img]

[h2] [b]See You Next Time[/b] [/h2]

We feel that going into Early Access with v0.40 was the right choice. Having our servers up 24/7 has been an excellent opportunity for the team to experience live operation with all its ups and downs unpredictable hurdles and funny discoveries alongside all of you! We feel your passion for the game and world of Steel Hunters and can't thank you enough for joining us on this journey. So get out there and hunt some steel!

All the best 
Raegnim

Live Ops' Resident Cat with Human Ears

notes.title: Making of Taurus
notes.notes:
Some Hunters are tactical and calculated. Some are precise. Taurus? He was made to charge headfirst into fights destroy anything in sight and either win the fight or die trying. "I am going to wreck stuff and I'm going to wreck YOU!" is how Emre Bugday a Technical Game Designer described Taurus.

And that's exactly who he turned out to be. From the very beginning the team knew that the Hunter roster needed a true brawler—a Hunter who wants to fight and has a thirst for dominance.

[img]https://sh-portal-prod.wgcdn.co/sh-portal-prod/portal_media/v041_SMM_IN_ARTICLE_c62bd8e7fd.jpg[/img]

[h2]Just a Cool Guy[/h2]

That's what you might think when you see Taurus for the first time. And that's fair but the vision here was much deeper. The team wanted to build a Hunter with a strong emotional core—strong enough to resonate throughout the design abilities and voice lines. That's where the short-tempered bull with a character was born!

[img]https://sh-portal-prod.wgcdn.co/sh-portal-prod/portal_media/p01_v041_Branding_Asstes_F_and_F_1920x1080_Making_of_Taurus_ab2107fd4e.png[/img]

There was one thing the devs knew they wanted to do when brainstorming for the next Hunter. "We just wanted to make a cool guy!" said Anton Oparin Art Director. "We discussed other potential options that would fit his stocky build—a rhino ram even a minotaur. But in the end a bull was the best fit on all fronts." That's when Taurus started looking a little more like how we all know him now—with a septum piercing and big f****** horns.

Maybe just a little more... scrappy. Like he was thrown together in a junkyard—which honestly wouldn't be that far from the truth. Taurus was originally meant to be a part of the Scrapper faction survivors making do with whatever they could salvage on an abandoned Earth. That rough patched-together look with many spikes worn metal and a punkish beaten-up vibe was a reflection of that. Another source of inspiration was his background. Nigel Davies as he was called when he was a human grew up and spent a lot of time in places where surviving meant being the toughest guy in the room. That also informed the way he looked.

[img]https://sh-portal-prod.wgcdn.co/sh-portal-prod/portal_media/p02_v041_Branding_Asstes_F_and_F_1920x1080_Making_of_Taurus_After_eaa4f399b0.png[/img]
[img]https://sh-portal-prod.wgcdn.co/sh-portal-prod/portal_media/p02_v041_Branding_Asstes_F_and_F_1920x1080_Making_of_Taurus_Before_2beee1f736.png[/img]
[i]Scrapper Taurus sketch versus current Taurus[/i] 

Things changed when Taurus moved to the Syndicate faction. While his design stayed true to its roots his model went through some polishing and refining—more befitting for his new faction. His armor plates became less chaotic and filled with various pieces of scrap—mainly on his legs shoulders and head. He did keep some remnants of spikes on some parts serving as a small callback to his original design. Taurus' expression became less feral but it still keeps true to all of his qualities.

[img]https://sh-portal-prod.wgcdn.co/sh-portal-prod/portal_media/p03_v041_Branding_Asstes_F_and_F_1920x1080_Making_of_Taurus_6d25c18b15.png[/img]
[i]Sketches of power gauntlet design for Taurus[/i] 

Taurus has always carried his sawed-off semi-automatic heavy shotgun. Nothing was ever changed about this gameplay-wise. But visually the team has explored many various design iterations including multiple versions of an axe mixed with a shotgun or a power gauntlet. Eventually everyone settled on a design that turned the shotgun into a fully integrated cannon-prosthetic attached to his right arm.

[img]https://sh-portal-prod.wgcdn.co/sh-portal-prod/portal_media/p04_v041_Branding_Asstes_F_and_F_1920x1080_Making_of_Taurus_ae9961af5f.png[/img]
[i]Shotgun design variations[/i] 

[h2]Making a Bull Out of a Mosquito[/h2]

When a Taurus player does Taurus things (like running right up into enemies' faces) they put themselves in constant danger. And even though it would be on-brand for Taurus to run in with his bare robotic fists we're not sending him into battle unprepared. "Taurus has all the tools to survive. You just got to keep on using the abilities and you got to keep on using them at the right moment " explains Balance Designer Doruk Coskun.

And there lies the mastery of Taurus—learning the right combinations at the right time to tap into the defensive and offensive capabilities of his kit. A good example of that is Taurus' main weapon—his shotgun. Combining the right things even before dropping down to the Hunting Grounds and knowing how to utilize them there can turn it into a great source of survivability during a fight (looking at you Brawl Mod)!

His shotgun is no ordinary one either. In the sense that it doesn't [i]have[/i] to behave like a typical shotgun. "I find the zooming effect on it very interesting! It expands the gameplay opportunities of Taurus without breaking the expectations on brawler playstyle & shotgun archetype." explains Doruk. Even though Taurus wasn't designed to play as a long-range Hunter the zooming effect on his shotgun enables Taurus to take poking shots before committing to an engagement. Enemies who barely manage to get away from Taurus are in for a rude awakening.

[img]https://sh-portal-prod.wgcdn.co/sh-portal-prod/portal_media/p05_v041_Branding_Asstes_F_and_F_1920x1080_Making_of_Taurus_c740faec27.png[/img]

"He's like that mosquito you try to shoo away—always in your face! But you know bigger." Emre joked. Taurus strives to always be in the thick of the fight. His entire kit is built around that rewarding those who charge headfirst into danger and punishing anyone too slow to react.

His signature Bull Charge ability embodies that perfectly letting him rush straight at his enemies—right where he wants to be. Once it's triggered he barrels forward slamming into his enemy or crashing into a rock. It's not just a mechanical fit either—it reflects his character too. "It's like seeing red—the player has only limited control over it. So even thematically I think it fits very well as well " explains Doruk.

His second ability Power Pylon helps him last longer in fights by reducing the amount of damage he takes. It was a tough fit at first. As a concept Power Pylon seemed like a good idea but it didn't really fit Taurus' playstyle. "He is meant to be mobile always on the move and Pylon meant that he had to stick around it to get full benefit of it " explains Emre. The team tweaked it so the buffs linger even after Taurus moves out of the Pylon's zone which allowed him to keep his aggressive tempo up while still getting all the benefits. "As a Hunter that banner is a mark of claim—a brutal declaration: 'This ground is mine' '" adds Anton.

Just like his rugged exterior Taurus' kit went through multiple reworks. Before the Power Pylon he cycled through two different versions of the same core idea: a grappling hook. The first version of it let him pull his enemies straight into his shotgun's sweet spot—a no nonsense move fitting his aggressive playstyle. In its second version the grappling hook became arguably even more chaotic as it let him steal enemy consumables mid-combat. It could've been a Health Kit Revive Booster or even Colossus—nothing was safe! "It was hilarious! But ultimately it was too powerful and honestly a little toxic " laughs Game Designer Georgii Gorin. "There was no counterplay to it and it had many other problems."

[img]https://sh-portal-prod.wgcdn.co/sh-portal-prod/portal_media/p07_v041_Branding_Asstes_F_and_F_1920x1080_Making_of_Taurus_4278999cd3.png[/img]
[i]Showcase of the first versions of grappling hook[/i] 

Though the hook looked awesome it wasn't just balance that was the problem. There were many technical issues with the chain clipping inside the environment and network issues causing many visual and gameplay bugs.

This mechanic is gone but you can have a look below at roughly what it looked like in game in the past. And who knows? The hook is a very cool ability and it may return one day with a fresh twist as part of a future Hunter's kit!

[h2]Taurus & Players[/h2]

Taurus isn't subtle and that's exactly why we think people will love him. "It all comes down to the idea of him being a fearless bull that's ready to bully his opponents " explained Georgii. His aggressive playstyle combined with a bold and brash personality makes him very easily recognizable among the rest of the Hunter roster.

We hope that players will also appreciate how real he is. Raw unfiltered. He isn't a soldier or a hero. He doesn't have a "polished" personality like other Hunters. He's a fighter you would expect to find somewhere in a bar throwing punches—one thing he has in common with Ursus.

He's still that same kid who's trying to fight his way through life. And that can be very magnetic energy for players who want to try him out on the Hunting Grounds—even if he has a very steep learning curve. In our tests we saw that new players often struggled with finding the right opportunities. In that sense playing as Taurus is very unforgiving—if you hesitate or miscalculate you lose. But those who push through master his abilities and learn to navigate the battlefield with him can easily perform among the top players.

[img]https://sh-portal-prod.wgcdn.co/sh-portal-prod/portal_media/p06_v041_Branding_Asstes_F_and_F_1920x1080_Making_of_Taurus_d5903a0a66.png[/img]

[h2]Fortune Favors the Bold[/h2]

That's what designers agreed to be the Taurus' design mantra. And for sure he isn't everyone's cup of tea. If you're a brains-over-brawn type of player and you like to think things through Taurus might not be your guy.

He's a wrecking ball a battering ram with no brakes and a nightmare for anyone who gets in his way. But if you've got the guts to charge headfirst into the fight Taurus is waiting.

notes.title: Changelog V0.41
notes.notes:
Please note that servers will be unavailable on [b]29/04/2025[/b] between [b]06:00 UTC[/b] and [b]12:00 UTC[/b] as we deploy update 0.41. For live updates, please join the official [url=https://discord.gg/steelhunters]Discord server[/url].

[h2] [b]Hunters[/b] [/h2]
[h3] [b]General[/b] [/h3]
[list][*]Added ability to cancel charging weapons and abilities with the reload button.
[*]Increased weapon ammo storage regeneration speed for all Hunters by 33% for the 2nd magazine and by 45% for the 3rd magazine.
[*]Improved critical hit registration.
[*]Adjusted Mod values and Hunter base stats related to magazine regeneration time.
[*]Updated the shooting experience for all Hunters including new muzzle flashes trails and impacts.
[*]Weapons now have different impact visual effects depending on whether the target has shields or not.
[*]Added new visual effects for critical hits.
[*]Added new sound effects for hits: the sound differs depending on whether the enemy has shields or not and whether it is a critical hit or not.
[*]Added smoking barrel visual effects after shooting automatic/semi-automatic weapons.
[*]Improved positioning of Hunters' legs on various uneven surfaces.
[*]Players can now view and apply Skins for Hunters in the Appearance menu.
[*]Improved melee experience:
[list][*]Reduced melee cooldown from 6 to 3 seconds for all Hunters.
[*]Shortened melee distances.
[*]Increased reliability of UI indication for melee and reduced discrepancies between initial melee start and actual point of contact.
[/list][/list][h3] [b]Taurus[/b] [/h3]
🛈 [i] [b]Taurus is our Brawler Hunter.[/b] [/i] 
 [i]We intended him to be right in the middle of the battle and provided him with the tools to get there—and stay there. He can be customized to be more sustainable during a fight or to become a damage-dealing tank. Regardless he shines when pushed to his limits. Knowing when to go in and when to disengage will be the crucial factor in utilizing his kit.[/i] 
 [i]His shotgun is destructive at close range but unique in the sense that it can be scoped in to provide damage capabilities at farther distances.[/i] 
 [i]Taurus is very territorial marking his space with his [b]Power Pylon[/b] . Depending on the Power Pylon Mod chosen he can claim a large area or deploy multiple pylons to "carry" his flag with him.[/i] 
 [i]We hope our players enjoy the on-the-edge highly interactive and high-speed playstyle he provides.[/i]

[*]Shield – 2 100

[/list][*]Effect 2

[/list][*]Effect 3
[list][*]Regain [b]1 500/2 750[/b] structure points upon destroying an enemy Hunter.
[/list][/list][/list] [b]System Tree – Unique Nodes[/b] 
[list][*]Unique Node 1
[list][*]The Power Pylon reveals enemy Hunters in a [b]200 m[/b] radius for [b]3 s[/b] after placing it and for another [b]3 s[/b] after it expires.
[/list][*]Unique Node 2
[list][*]Taurus creates an explosion that deals [b]1 300[/b] damage in a [b]22 m[/b] radius on impact or when Bull Charge ends.
[/list][*]Unique Node 3
[list][*]Destroying a target with Bull Charge does not end the effect. Instead Taurus crashes through the target and the ability duration is refreshed.
[/list][/list][h3] [b]Heartbreaker[/b] [/h3]
[list][*]Heartbreaker's System Tree Nodes that increase her Stealth duration now show values to two decimal places instead of rounding to integers.
[/list]🛈 [i] [b]Heartbreaker's weapon changes[/b] aim to address two key issues raised regarding her Railgun.[/i] 
 [i]First we wanted to remove artificial damage limiters in the form of reverse falloff (a reduction in her damage at close range) and highlight her long-range capabilities by making her the only Hunter without long-range damage falloff. We believe that by introducing the Scope-In mechanic (a base damage increase while scoped) we can increase player agency in close-range encounters—while still ensuring that these situations remain disadvantageous for her preserving her identity as a long-range specialist.[/i] 
 [i]Second Heartbreaker stands out as an outlier in terms of damage output relative to player skill level. We've observed that she excels in the hands of highly skilled players who can consistently land critical hits whereas newer players may struggle to bridge that skill gap. The Scope-In mechanic serves a dual purpose: it reduces the punishment for missing a perfect critical hit offering a leg-up for players still learning her precise weapon while still leaving plenty of room for skill expression.[/i] 
 [i]We embrace the competitive nature of our game and we've ensured that skilled play remains rewarded—fully scoped-in critical hits still deal the same amount of damage. We've also updated her Markswoman Mod which now works in tandem with the newly introduced Scope-In mechanic.[/i] 
 [b]Railgun[/b] 
[list][*]Base Behavior
[list][*]Removed damage falloff.
[*]Added Scope-In:
[list][*]Scoping for 1.8 s increases shot damage by 20% and reduces scatter.
[*]Shot damage increases are shown by the UI in four stages; each stage is +5%.
[/list][*]Reduced crit modifier from 80% → 50%.
[/list][*]Mod: Markswoman
[list][*]Renamed from Mod: Marksman → Mod: Markswoman.
[*]Updated scatter to reduce exponentially.
[list][*]Scatter reduces quicker and earlier but ends at the same point.
[/list][*]Changed Effect 1
[list][*]Increases damage when aiming down sights → Scope-In max damage bonus is 23/26/29/32/35%.
[/list][*]Changed Effect 2
[list][*]Reduces scatter when aiming down sights → Reduces Scope-In time to 1.7/1.65/1.6/1.5 s.
[/list][*]Changed Effect 3
[list][*]The 3rd consecutive hit on the same target restores 10/20% structure → The last shot in the magazine restores 1 250/2 500 structure.
[/list][/list][*]Mod: Focus
[list][*]Renamed Mod: Duelist → Mod: Focus.
[*]Changed Effect 1
[list][*]Increases damage dealt by last shot in the magazine by [b]14/18/22/26/30%[/b] if all other shots hit the same target → Increases damage dealt by the last shot in the magazine by 10/15/20/25/30%.
[/list][/list][/list]🛈 [i]We've also been listening to feedback regarding the [b]Sonar Pulse[/b] ability—particularly the frustrating scenarios that the silence debuff created—and we wanted to expand the playstyles available to Heartbreaker. We're shifting Sonar Pulse in a new direction: a tool that empowers team play and acts as an indirect means of increasing both her and her squadmates' damage output.[/i] 
 [i]With the renewed Mod variations we believe we're offering more flexibility for players—whether they prefer diving into the action or keeping their distance while being a menace from afar.[/i] 
 [b]Sonar Pulse[/b] 
[list][*]Base Behavior
[list][*]Added that using the ability reveals Heartbreaker to enemies within Sonar range for 3 s.

[/list][*]Added Effect 2

[/list][*]Added Effect 3
[list][*]When a revealed Hunter is destroyed by Heartbreaker or her ally 50% of magazine ammo is refunded.
[/list][/list][*]Mod: Tracker
[list][*]Reworked Base Behavior

[/list][*]Base Stats

[/list][/list][/list][h3] [b]Prophet[/b] [/h3]

[/list][h3] [b]Ursus[/b] [/h3]
[list][*]Changed Ursus' Missile Barrage behavior to end automatically if there is no ammo left in the magazine.

[/list][h3] [b]Colossus[/b] [/h3]

notes.title: Season 1 BattlePass 1 - Overview
notes.notes:
[h2]Hello everyone![/h2]

The first BattlePass of Steel Hunters Season 1 Infamous starts on the 29th of April and it kick off with a bang! The (long-awaited) arrival of Taurus will soon be here but the season’s free BattlePass has much more to offer. And you can earn all of it simply through gameplay! Learn how at the end of the article.

[i]Are you ready to take the bull by the horns?[/i] 

[previewyoutube=znF-6Jtif3E;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3][/h3]

[h2]Taurus - New Hunter[/h2]

The star of this BattlePass is none other than Taurus the Unstoppable Brawler.

Never heard of him? Impossible. This close to midrange specialist is armed with a shotgun and a lot of bravado! If you're not afraid to charge headfirst into the middle of the fight to get up close and personal with your enemies we are sure you will become good friends quickly. You can read more about his abilities in our previous [url=https://steelhunters.com/en/news/620-taurus-kit]article[/url] .

Taurus can be unlocked instantly in the Premium Tier or by reaching level 59 of the Pro Tier.

[i]Note: Including Hunters in the BattlePass is one of the ways we’re experimenting with progression during early access. Your feedback helps shape what’s next![/i] 

[img]https://sh-portal-prod.wgcdn.co/sh-portal-prod/portal_media/p01_v041_Branding_Asstes_1920x1080_BP_Infamous_Overview_75293f558a.png[/img]
[h2][/h2]

[h2]Skins Boosters and More[/h2]

But of course that's not all. The BattlePass is full of skins ranging from Grade 1 to Grade 3 for all Hunters across all Tiers!

Check out Taurus’s “Prison Robe” skin and others below!

Apart from Taurus and shiny new skins you will also be rewarded with plenty of resources to upgrade your Hunters! Look forward to all kinds of Boosters Upgrade Cores and Credits!

[h2]Want more?[/h2]

If you think 60 levels are not enough don’t worry — the fun doesn’t stop there. You can continue earning rewards even after reaching the end of the BattlePass. These repeatable levels can grant you bonuses such as Credits Starfall Upgrade Cores and additional Boosters!

[h3]How to unlock the BattlePass for free?[/h3]

Our BattlePass has 3 tiers — Free Pro and Premium. You can unlock the Pro Tier for 100 Platinum and the Premium Tier for 200 Platinum. Through Combat Missions which reset every day you can earn 3 Platinum per unlocked Hunter and collect enough Platinum to unlock all tiers for free!

Are you a new player? You will get a 100 Platinum reward by completing the onboarding!

[img]https://sh-portal-prod.wgcdn.co/sh-portal-prod/portal_media/p05_v041_Branding_Asstes_1920x1080_EN_BP_Infamous_Overview_5b9c652bf8.png[/img]
 [i]See combat missions by clicking the button on the right in hangar[/i] 

[h3]How to progress the BattlePass?[/h3]

To progress the BattlePass level you’ll need to collect BattlePass Points where every 100 points unlocks the next BattlePass level.
Points can be earned by completing the weekly missions which reset every Tuesday at 13:00 UTC or by completing some of the Combat Missions which reset every day.

notes.title: Hunter Stories: Taurus
notes.notes:
[h3]Everything starts somewhere...
[/h3] 
Taurus’s story, the real story, began when he was just a boy. Pushing through hardships and pain shaped him. And over time he learned to love those two things. They were what helped him survive, they became his fuel.
 
Make no mistake, he does not want your pity. His past made him a warrior, the winner that he is today.
 
[b]Fight with Taurus. Claim your victory on 29th of April!
[/b]

notes.title: v0.41 Version Highlights
notes.notes:
Do you hear that in the distance? That rumbling getting closer every day? Watch out it's the Version Highlights for Steel Hunters version 0.41! And with our new version comes our first new Hunter Taurus! This raging bull of the Syndicate has beef with everything in the Hunting Grounds!

[img]https://sh-portal-prod.wgcdn.co/sh-portal-prod/portal_media/p01_v041_Branding_Asstes_1920x1080_Version_Highlights_519eef465e.png[/img]

In the words of our devs: "He is big he is mean and he is here to bull-y you! Pun intended... He’s making a headfirst entrance to our roster—just like he loves to dive into battle with his Bull Charge. He isn't afraid to claim the battlefield with his banner Power Pylon and he's ready to back up his smirky comments with his Heavy Shotgun (beware of his zoom!). He’s in your face living on the edge and disrupting everything in his way while he's at it."

Look out for upcoming publications diving deeper into Taurus' kit and playstyle.

[img]https://sh-portal-prod.wgcdn.co/sh-portal-prod/portal_media/p02_v041_Branding_Asstes_1920x1080_Version_Highlights_1be1626711.png[/img]

You're probably wondering how you'll be able to add Taurus to your Hunter roster. For version 0.41 Taurus makes his debut exclusively in our 'Infamous' BattlePass. But don't worry—we're committed to ensuring that [b]all Hunters[/b]  including Taurus  [b]will always have a free path to unlock them[/b] .

For just 100 Platinum—easily [b]obtainable through Combat Missions[/b] —you can upgrade to the [b]PRO BattlePass[/b] . Reach level 59 and Taurus is yours to keep!

Alternatively upgrading to the [b]PREMIUM BattlePass[/b] for an additional 100 Platinum (200 if you skip PRO) grants you [b]instant access to Taurus[/b] . The PREMIUM track also includes exclusive skins credits and plenty of other goodies to unlock as you progress. We've designed the BattlePass to feel valuable and rewarding let us know what you think!

[b]![/b] Should you miss out on this BattlePass Taurus will become available for Constructs like our other Hunters starting in version 0.42.

[img]https://sh-portal-prod.wgcdn.co/sh-portal-prod/portal_media/p03_v041_Branding_Asstes_1920x1080_EN_Version_Highlights_37ed1d5f17.png[/img]

A new version wouldn't be the same without some balance updates! We're still compiling all the information you've been providing since Early Access launched but a common point has been Heartbreaker. She's a bit like marmite: some of you love her some hate her but it's strong opinions all around!

We're rolling out some large updates to her Railgun and Sonar Pulse to help empower her team play. Key points include shifting more power into her scoped fire and adding more support utility into Sonar Pulse.

Just because she's sitting back and laying down precision fire shouldn't mean that her team mate feels alone in the front! You'll be able to see the full scope of these changes in Changelog v0.41 soon.

You might have seen that we're updating the in-game HUD. This is in response to hearing your feedback from our playtests that the center of the screen was too cluttered. We think the new one looks pretty snazzy even for a starting point and there will be more improvements on the horizon. Even this picture is just a work-in-progress and size of abilities and consumables should be larger by the time it's in your hands!

We're also introducing our first pass at our new in-battle Stats screen. With it it should be easier than ever to see how strong you are at any stage of a Battle.

[img]https://sh-portal-prod.wgcdn.co/sh-portal-prod/portal_media/p04_v041_Branding_Asstes_1920x1080_Version_Highlights_e526935730.png[/img]

We've also redone all the models for the all the interactables minus enhancement cores. (Sorry enhancement cores!) We wanted to make sure that even the basic Energy Cell has some Steel Hunters flair and is deserving of its place in the near post-apocalyptic future!

With some awesome new effects included we want to make our game look unique while improving visibility. Is it really worth going after that Special Kit in the middle of a firefight? Well now you can easily tell it's a Shield Dome it might just be!

We'll also be rolling out the first the changes towards what we call Melee 2.0 with version 0.41. We want melee combat to be a satisfying part of your battle plan. Just because you're a 20 foot tall dog with a rocket launcher doesn't mean you shouldn't be able to get up close and personal with your claws!

We're starting small with reductions to cooldown and range and a more reliable prompt to let you know a target is in range. But we want to hear how it feels to you and how you'd like to see it develop from here.

We know that our current progression system can feel a bit jarring. We hear you! We're continuing to look at pain points in the leveling process and will be making changes and adjustments. This kicks off with [b]a 50% Credit cost reduction to all Unique Nodes to balance their cost vs other nodes[/b] .

You can find more information about Unique Nodes and their role in the System Tree article [url=https://steelhunters.com/en/news/400-sys-tre] [u]here[/u] [/url].

Anyone who has purchased of these Nodes in Version 0.40 will be issued a refund for the Credit difference. This is just the starting point for many iterations to come as it [b]is[/b] called Early Access for a reason!

Finally Version 0.41 will include the first iteration of our Shop. Here we'll have skins for all your favorite Hunters available for Platinum. The offers will rotate weekly so just because you don't see what you're looking for immediately doesn't mean it won't be there during Version 0.41 or beyond.

Our team is hard at work cooking up some especially cool skins so jump in when the patch drops and take a look at our sweet shop offers!

Thank you! We can't wait to moo-ove around the Hunting Grounds with the rest of you when Version 0.41 drops at the end of the month. Let us know what changes you're most excited for when the Changelog drops in the near future.

All the best 

Raegnim

notes.title: Why Your Feedback Matters
notes.notes:
Welcome to Early Access Hunters! As you're jumping into Steel Hunters, your feedback—both excitement and frustrations—plays a key role in shaping our game. Whether you're new here or have been helping us test for a while your ideas and experiences help make Steel Hunters better.

[h2]Your Role in Our Development[/h2]

Steel Hunters isn't developed in isolation. As a live-service game Steel Hunters is being built to be around for years to come and we know from experience that the only way to keep a game alive over such periods is to involve players into the process.

We want to share how your feedback moves from a great idea to something you actually experience in the game. It’s a process and here's why it sometimes takes longer than you'd expect.

[h2]Understanding the Dev Cycle (Why Changes Take Time)[/h2]

When a new version of Steel Hunters goes live we're already wrapping up the development of the next version. This means feedback received today can typically not be incorporated earlier than two versions down the line. Why? Because each feature or improvement requires careful planning coding testing and refining to make sure it fits smoothly into the game without introducing new issues.

 [b]Quick Disclaimer:[/b] Game development can be complex and sometimes unpredictable. While some suggestions might seem simple even minor changes often have deeper impacts that need thorough testing to ensure they enhance—not break—your gaming experience.

[h2]Player Feedback in Action – Version 0.40 - End of April[/h2]

You've already influenced Steel Hunters significantly. Here are some recent improvements shaped directly by your suggestions from earlier testing:

[list][*] [b]Instant pickups:[/b] Players told us picking up items felt clunky interrupting the action. We made most pickups instant to keep gameplay smooth and engaging while keeping critical items (like repair kits) a discrete action that can be interrupted.

[*] [b]Reduced cooldown from sprint to firing:[/b] Your feedback highlighted how long cooldowns broke the flow of combat so we shortened them letting you react quicker during fights.

[*] [b]Better skill trees:[/b] You said skill trees felt limited and basic. You can see the beginning of our work with the new System Trees in game. Going forward we will expand on this framework to ensure you have more meaningful choices to make.

[/list][h2]Coming Soon – Version 0.41[/h2]

The next set of improvements directly inspired by your feedback is already in testing:

[list][*] [b]Cheaper unique skill tree nodes:[/b] You felt these nodes were too expensive. We've reduced their credit cost by 50% and will refund any credits spent previously on unique nodes. We will keep monitoring and adjusting credit income and sinks until we are happy with the overall balance.

[*] [b]Streamlined HUD:[/b] Many of you said the HUD was cluttered and distracting. We’ve simplified it for easier readability.

[img]https://sh-portal-prod.wgcdn.co/sh-portal-prod/portal_media/v040_Article_Asstes_Feedback_Matters_1920x1080_HUD_18b05a2161.jpg[/img]

[/list][list][*] [b]Clearer match progression indicators[/b] : You wanted more visibility into how your upgrades and levels impact gameplay so we've made this clearer during matches. We will expand on this later on to add your abilities and how Ability Power affects them.

[img]https://sh-portal-prod.wgcdn.co/sh-portal-prod/portal_media/v040_Article_Asstes_Feedback_Matters_1920x1080_Progression_68ae446c50.jpg[/img]

[/list][list][*] [b]Faster ammo recharge:[/b] Ammo shortages felt frustrating so we sped up ammo recharge times especially when you are low on mags.

[*] [b]Improved melee combat:[/b] You found melee too restrictive so we've adjusted cooldowns and attack ranges. Let us know what else you'd like to improve as we work towards Melee 2.0!

[*] [b]Flexible mission logic:[/b] Some missions previously forced specific Hunters. Now any Hunter can complete them offering more freedom in playstyle choices—albeit with higher mission requirements.

[*] [b]Heatbreaker rebalance:[/b] Your feedback indicated that Sonar Pulse silence was overly punishing and frustrating to play against. It now only interrupts channeled abilities and consumables without full silencing while it also reveals your position for strategic counterplay. Note that this is just one of the balance changes coming to her in 0.41.

[/list][h2] [b]Staying Involved and Making a Difference[/b] [/h2]

We gather feedback from everywhere—Discord Steam surveys gameplay data and more—and your input helps shape what we focus on next. Our community and dev teams work hand in hand to find key ideas and suggestions respond to concerns and keep you in the loop through regular updates and retrospectives. If you want your voice heard the best way is to hop into our [url=https://discord.com/invite/steelhunters]Discord server[/url] and join the [url=https://discord.com/channels/809429230727069717/1313439599837843477]#suggestions-and-feedback[/url] forum this helps us immensely even if you just upvote other great ideas!

Together we're building Steel Hunters into something special. So keep the feedback coming—we’re listening.

notes.title: Login Issues Resolved
notes.notes:
Hunters,

First off—thank you to everyone who jumped into Steel Hunters at launch yesterday! We’re incredibly excited (and grateful) to see so many of you eager to join the fight.

[h3]Login Issues[/h3]
We want to acknowledge the login queue issue that affected many players shortly after we went live on Steam. From 12:00 UTC to around 15:50 UTC, a bug in our backend system caused login requests to be processed [b]sequentially[/b] instead of [b]concurrently[/b]. This significantly slowed down queue times and, in many cases, blocked players from logging in at all.

The problem has since been fixed, and the login queue has normalized. You should now be able to jump in without issue.

[h3]Account Creation Issues[/h3]
[b]Wargaming Accounts[/b]
[list]
We’ve had some reports that issues can occur when attempting to log in to existing Wargaming accounts through Steam. If you’re affected, please [url=https://wargaming.net/support/en/products/steel/help/][b]contact our support team[/b][/url]—we’ll help resolve it!
[/list]
[h3]Stay Connected & Share Your Feedback[/h3]
We’re sorry for the rocky start—launch days are wild, and this one was no exception. Your patience and support during those first hours mean a lot to us.

👉 For more details about Steel Hunters Early Access, and to learn about the [b]free battle pass[/b] you can unlock just by playing, check out our Early Access Launch Article. https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1691340/view/527590540141660103?l=english

[b]And finally, we’d love to hear what you think.[/b] Join the conversation on our [url=https://discord.gg/steelhunters][b]Discord[/b][/url] or drop your feedback on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1691340/discussions/][b]Steam Community Forum[/b][/url].

Thanks again—and we’ll see you in the arena.

—The Steel Hunters Team

notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=oqS1H-hec3Q;full][/previewyoutube]

Headstrong and stoic Henrietta Björnsdottir worked as a struggling miner before and after Mayday Omega. Upon discovering the suffering Scrappers abandoned on Earth Henrietta championed their cause and went on to become the First Hunter—one that wasn't created in a lab but was rather forged through pain and sacrifice amid a fierce battle for Scrapper independence. Now she's ready to take down anyone who threatens the livelihood of any of her Scrappers.

Our Hunter Stories reflect on the defining events each hero faced before they became Hunters—and paint the emotions and motivations that lead them to the Hunting Grounds. Every Hunter carries the essence of their former flesh-and-blood self now encased in metal; each battle reveals how they survived the apocalypse and in every Hunter Genesis there's a spark that ignites hope among their followers.

notes.title: The Forge - System Tree 3.0
notes.notes:
[h2] [b]Welcome Hunters![/b] [/h2]

Growth in life is often described with metaphors like "forging yourself in fire " "leveling up " or "reaching the next level." When it comes to Steel Hunters "forging " "leveling up " and "reaching the next level" do find a visually suitable representation in-game— [b]our new System Tree[/b] . It connects back to life in a simple way: [b]forging your own path[/b] . The [b]revamped System Tree[/b] was designed to put power back in your hands. It creates [b]fair predictable and balanced scaling[/b] while also allowing for more meaningful choices in shaping your Hunter's strengths on the road to Level 40.

[img]https://sh-portal-prod.wgcdn.co/sh-portal-prod/portal_media/v040_Branding_Asstes_Game_Guide_1920x1080_Power_Tree_4_3b3fdd16a9.png[/img]
[h3] [b]Why This Matters[/b] [/h3]

[list][*] [b]Consistent Scaling[/b] : All Hunters follow the same rules making balance easier.[*] [b]Clear Progression[/b] : You know exactly how much power comes from the System Tree vs. in-battle scaling.[*] [b]Better Control[/b] : We can finetune balance across different game stages (as you level up your Hunters through the System Tree and throughout battles).[/list]In this article we'll walk you through exactly how our revamped System Tree works.

[h2] [b]All Things Balanced as They Should Be[/b] [/h2]

From Version 0.40 on we're changing how [b]ability power (AP) and the System Tree[/b] affect your Hunters' abilities.

[list][*] [b]Ability power (AP)[/b] : Represents the strength of an ability which increases as each battle progresses.[*] [b]System Tree[/b] : Enables synergy between pre-battle decisions and in-battle performance ensuring every choice matters.[/list][h3] [b]Key Changes:[/b] [/h3]

All abilities that scale with ability power will continue to scale during each battle based on your Hunter level progression and the Enhancement Cores you collect. This mainly applies to abilities related to "Time to Kill" (TTK)—like applicable offensive powers or healing abilities. However the main source of power for your abilities comes from the System Tree.

[h3] [b]Here's How It Works:[/b] [/h3]

Let's take Razorside's Frag Grenade—Detonator Mod. When first equipped it starts with [b]2 000 explosion damage[/b] . Upgrading it via [b]ability stat upgrade Nodes[/b] in the System Tree increases the [b]explosion damage by +150[/b] .
 [b]Ability power[/b] comes into play after you get in a battle. As your Hunter gains more levels and collects Cores  [b]2 150[/b] explosion damage also scales through [b]ability power[/b] .

[h3] [b]For example:[/b] [/h3]

[list][*]Reaching the second level provides a [b]3%[/b] ability power increase:[list][*]Starting from [b]2 000 [/b] you would reach [b]2 060[/b] .[*]Starting from [b]2 150[/b]  you would reach [b]2 215[/b] .[/list][/list]This can be further increased by leveling up and picking up Cores until you [b]reach an incredible 80%![/b] 

[table equalcells=1][tr][th] [b]Base Damage[/b] [/th][th] [b]Level 2 (+3%)[/b] [/th][th] [b]Level 3 (+9%)[/b] [/th][th] [b]Max (+80% Hunter Leveling + Enhancement Cores)[/b] [/th][/tr][tr][td]2 000[/td][td]2 060[/td][td]2 180[/td][td] [b]3 600[/b] [/td][/tr][tr][td]2 150 (with Node)[/td][td]2 215[/td][td]2 344[/td][td] [b]3 870[/b] [/td][/tr][/table]

In the table your base stat of [b]+150 turned[/b] into a [b]+270[/b] during the battle. And just imagine gathering +80% ability power throughout a battle! The more you invest in the System Tree the stronger your abilities become as the battle progresses.

[h2] [b]It's in Your Hands[/b] [/h2]

With this update  [b]ability power (AP)[/b] and the [b]System Tree[/b] now work together for smoother more balanced progression. All base abilities—whether damage healing or unique effects—scale through the [b]System Tree[/b] . However only [b]offensive and healing abilities[/b] (affecting [i]Time to Kill[/i] ) continue to scale dynamically during a battle as you level up and collect [b]Enhancement Cores[/b] . Abilities like Heartbreaker's [b]Stealth[/b] don't scale with ability power (AP) because they don't directly impact offensive strength health or shields. Instead these abilities improve through other factors such as increased duration.

There are [b]three types of[/b]  [b]C[/b]  [b]ores[/b] — [b]Structure Shields and Damage[/b] —all providing equal AP increases based on their tier. This ensures predictable fair scaling while still allowing for dynamic progression. All Hunters now follow the same scaling rules making balance adjustments easier and progression clearer. You'll always know where your power comes from allowing for smarter build choices.

[h2] [b]Sources of Ability Power[/b] [/h2]

The following chart shows you a base approach to increasing AP through the System Tree and in-game enhancement but keep in mind that there are more ways to upgrade your base AP. Specific gear that you'll be able to earn for your Hunter can be tied to an increase in base AP on the Hunting Grounds upleveling their stats.

[h2] [b]New in V0.40: More Ways to Mess With Your Enemies[/b] [/h2]

The [b]first iteration of this new System Tree[/b] arrives in [b]Version 0.40[/b]  featuring a [b]universal structure[/b] for all Hunters. Each tree consists of [b]15 Hunter stat Nodes[/b] and [b]8 ability stat Nodes[/b]  ensuring a balanced foundation across the board. While the structure is currently the same for every Hunter this is just the beginning—future updates will bring even more [b]variety and specialization[/b] .

Also a total of three Unique Nodes has been allocated for every Hunter further bringing out your hero's specific capabilities and thus influencing your playstyle.

[list][*]The System Tree is divided into 4 sections that unlock as Players reach a certain number of unlocked nodes and Hunter Level on a given Hunter:

But let's also look into some examples of this directly. Playing Ursus you may now gain the option to violently shatter your Glacial Armor once the effect ends dealing damage to enemies within a 25 m radius. This rewards a more aggressive playstyle giving you the chance to take on enemies head on whilst cushioned in your formidable shell—only to have it explode in their faces as the effect comes to an end. "Keep your friends close but your enemies even closer"—one might want to say.

Unique Nodes for Heartbreaker include instant Stealth activation once her health falls below 35% or granting her allies Stealth as long as they stay within a 75 m radius. Fighting an invisible team would pose quite the challenge. So how great is it that Prophet's Unique Nodes include one that marks enemies who were hit by Vengeance Strike—keeping them marked and able to be seen by him and his allies for 10 s even through objects? The endless tactical possibilities created through this system both add true character to your Hunter and add to the depth of gameplay. "It's not about the hand (Hunter) you're dealt with it's about how you play your cards (unique abilities)."

[img]https://sh-portal-prod.wgcdn.co/sh-portal-prod/portal_media/v040_Branding_Asstes_Game_Guide_1920x1080_Power_Tree_3_2599f137f8.png[/img]
[h2] [b]Future Plans for the System Tree[/b] [/h2]

One of the more exciting possibilities in terms of the biggest improvement this could open up one day is differentiating System Trees based on Hunter roles. Ability-focused Hunters could have more Ability Nodes while others might focus more on raw damage or defensive stats. Instead of a one-size-fits-all approach these adjustments would allow each Hunter to lean into their strengths and feel more unique. In a possible Steel Hunters future this could become a real thing. However it will require further testing and a more precise approach to be investigated as there is always a priority on keeping tight focus on Hunter balancing of course. Another exciting change could also be introducing dynamic progression paths: by adjusting the way Skill Trees branch out we can create meaningful decision points that allow for deeper customization. Unique Nodes will also be placed differently depending on the Hunter making progression feel even more tailored and strategic.

The new System Tree is just the beginning. With these improvements we're not only refining how Hunters scale but also [b]laying the foundation for an even deeper and more rewarding progression system[/b] . Whether you're looking to maximize your abilities finetune your stats or adapt your Hunter to your preferred playstyle  [b]this update gives you more control than ever before[/b] .

But we're not stopping here. We want to hear from [b]you[/b] ! Join the discussion on [url=https://discord.gg/steelhunters] [b][Discord][/b] [/url]  let us know your thoughts and be part of shaping the future of [b]Steel Hunters[/b] .

[h3]See you on the Hunting Grounds![/h3]

[previewyoutube=2y4C4Zu_iAc;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3] [b]Steel Hunters Glossary[/b] [/h3]

[list][*] [b]Ability Power (AP)[/b] : A stat that determines the strength of certain abilities. AP increases as you progress through a battle by leveling up and collecting enhancement cores.[*] [b]System Tree[/b] : The progression system where you upgrade your Hunter's stats and abilities.[*] [b]Enhancement Cores[/b] : In-battle items that enhance your Hunter's abilities. They come in five tiers—Level 1 Level 2 Level 3 Level 4 and Level 5—and increase ability power based on their rarity.[*] [b]Time to Kill (TTK)[/b] : A gameplay metric representing how long it takes to eliminate an enemy. Abilities affecting TTK (like offensive or healing abilities) scale with ability power.[*] [b]Unique Nodes[/b] : Special Nodes in the System Tree that provide exclusive Hunter-specific enhancements influencing gameplay style and strategy.[*] [b]Base Stats[/b] : The starting strength of abilities before any upgrades or in-battle scaling.[*] [b]Scaling[/b] : The process by which your Hunter's abilities become stronger as you progress in the game—through both the System Tree and in-battle progression (like level-ups and Core collection).[/list]
